Name: Kirtini's Filled In Crystal Path
Author: KirtiniBlon
Description:
Fills in the crystal paths to be like the cobblestone paths. My fiance wanted it to be less sparse when a single-wide path is placed so I learned how to mod and made this. Sorry if someone already did it, but I couldn't find anything.

This is a Content Patcher mod, so just unzip it into your Mods folder and you're good to go. Should be compatible with most mods unless they edit the crystal path in any way, then I have no idea. ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

If anyone has any issues let me know and I'll try to fix it when I can.
